Each item below shows symbols in a sequence; the last one listed is where the sequence has got to.
For each item, answer with one of:

  - "none": true, if nothing seems to come next
Any symbol may come next, whether it is shown or not; it may have no name.
If you can work out what comes next, give it, even if that takes some effort; "none" if nothing does.
Reason as much as you like, and look symbols up with the tools provided if that helps; judge each item on its own rather than building a scheme across items.

{"id": 0, "s": ["ↁ", "ↂ", "ↇ", "ↈ"]}
